title: I found a logic trap the Luddites hate.
author: PoopsMcScoots
selftext:
So, all the major engine are now developed with AI (Unity, unreal, Godot).

And no one would say a game made with them is AI slop.

But if I make a tool with AI and make a game with the tool then that’s AI slop.

If I gave my AI made tools to someone to make a game, would that be AI slop?

And if so, they why aren’t games made with an engine?

I posted this earlier and people were having a melt down.

comments.author: zayelion
comments.body: And that is why purity culture is stupid.

comments.author: frigginwizard420
comments.body:
They arent luddites, the luddites saw the working class as allies and attacked big businesses and the government.  

Anti AI people leave big business and the government alone and instead exclusively harass the working class, because they are giant pussies that wont even risk leaving their moms basements to do anything else.

comments.author: unlikely-ape
comments.body: Can we stop this us vs them gotchas? Put your head down, focus on your game, if it is good it will succeed if it is bad it won't fail because of anti AI crowds.

replies.author: unlikely-ape
replies.body: Then shoo and back to work lol

comments.author: niloony
comments.body:
Whining about AI hate is the new "game dev just depends on marketing and luck".

Focus on your game.

comments.author: admiral_aubrey
comments.body:
Congrats you pwned them, what did you win?

Just focus on making some good games, that's the only real scoreboard.

comments.author: Physical-Bite-3837
comments.body:
It's often believed by people that you need to do "hard work." As if hard work itself is what gives something value. Majority of the stuff we have we didn't work for. I didn't build any part of the house I'm living in. I didn't invent electricity. I didn't design the car that gets me to work everyday. I didn't do anything to be born in the united states and have access to things we are given just for being in a developed society.

Now one might say "Well you work at a job that gives you money to buy those things so technically you did work for them."  And if that's the argument, well then let me spend my money on AI credits to make a game. I have a job, that's my hard work.

replies.author: throwaway098242
replies.body: I mean, you're not getting paid for using electricity or living in your house though... What's your plan for when the people who put in years of work making games before are now switching to using AI and putting in the same hard work while also being assisted with AI?

comments.author: rb-cloud
comments.body:
How about this sub just stops talking about “antis”.

There is only one thing that will get people to accept AI games.

Good AI games.

No logic puzzles, no ethics debates, no tricks. Just good games.

comments.author: Aggressive_Tie_3014
comments.body:
If you make a shitty tool with AI that craps out games with Claude UI and tooltips, yes it would be slop.

But if it was actually identical to the big game engines, right down to being able to control every detail, I don't see why a game made with it would be slop. E.G. if the player controls every element, and no decision-making, writing, placement or creation of elements is left to an LLM's judgment.

I imagine just like if you vibecoded a copy of MSpaint, or if you vibecoded a copy of Notepad, an image or story made with them would still be human-made. But if you vibecoded a program that generates images and stories or music nobody would want it and rightfully call it slop.

Though I can't imagine how much money you'd waste trying to make something as detailed as Unity, or what the point would be to get AI to create what would probably only be a shittier version of it.

Anyways your gotcha is cringe.
